headers.name: x-77-pop
headers.source: https://client.cdn77.com/support/knowledgebase/caching-and-http-headers/headers-added-by-cdn77 (identifies the CDN77 edge that handled the request, such as pragueCZ), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.cdn77.com, client.cdn77.com and img.icons8.com (parisFR)

headers.name: x-77-cache
headers.source: https://client.cdn77.com/support/knowledgebase/caching-and-http-headers/headers-added-by-cdn77 (HIT when the edge served the response from its cache, MISS when it fetched it from the origin), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.cdn77.com and img.icons8.com

headers.name: x-77-nzt
headers.source: https://client.cdn77.com/support/knowledgebase/caching-and-http-headers/headers-added-by-cdn77 (internal header used for debugging), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.cdn77.com and img.icons8.com

headers.name: x-77-nzt-ray
headers.source: https://client.cdn77.com/support/knowledgebase/caching-and-http-headers/headers-added-by-cdn77 (internal header used for debugging), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.cdn77.com and img.icons8.com

server.source: https://client.cdn77.com/support/knowledgebase/caching-and-http-headers/understanding-http-headers (example response of a CDN Resource, with server: CDN77-Turbo next to the x-77 headers), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.cdn77.com, client.cdn77.com and img.icons8.com

cname.source: https://client.cdn77.com/support/knowledgebase/introduction-to-cdn/getting-started (every CDN Resource has a CDN URL such as 1234567890.rsc.cdn77.org, and a custom name is a CNAME to it), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.cdn77.com (1669655317.rsc.cdn77.org) and img.icons8.com (1004834818.rsc.cdn77.org), as the last name of the chain
